title: 1996 Topps The X-Files #41 Firewalker Episode Trading Card
descriptionText: The Topps 1996 The X-Files Trading Card #41 featuring the Episode Firewalker is an original non-sport trading card from the popular TV show The X-Files. Manufactured by Topps in the United States, this card is part of the base set and showcases the sci-fi genre of the series. With its standard size and English language, this collectible item appeals to fans of the franchise looking to add to their trading card singles collection.
